name: real-estate-landing-page
description: Premium real estate business landing page with SEO optimization and accessibility features

scripts.test: npm run test:seo && npm run test:accessibility
scripts.test:accessibility: node -e "const { AxePuppeteer } = require('@axe-core/puppeteer'); const puppeteer = require('puppeteer'); (async () => { const browser = await puppeteer.launch(); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto('http://localhost:3000'); const results = await new AxePuppeteer(page).analyze(); console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2)); await browser.close(); })();"

author: Real Estate Business
